product_summary: Oracle India Private Limited (India HQ: F-01/02, First Floor, Salcon Rasvillas, D-1 District Centre, Saket, New Delhi 110017 — per oracle.com/in/corporate/contact) is the Indian sales/support/marketing arm of Oracle Corp. Real product lines visible on oracle.com/in: (1) Oracle Cloud Infrastructure — cloud compute/storage/networking/AI capacity (subscription service); (2) Oracle AI Database, MySQL, Java, GraalVM, Linux/Virtualization, Fusion Middleware (software licences + support); (3) Fusion Cloud Applications (ERP, HCM, SCM, CX) and NetSuite SaaS; (4) Oracle Health and industry application suites (SaaS); (5) Hardware: Oracle Exadata, Oracle Database Appliance, Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance, Oracle Private Cloud Appliance, Oracle servers and Oracle storage (oracle.com/in/hardware, oracle.com/in/engineered-systems); (6) Oracle University training/certification and Customer Success Services. The overwhelming share of the Indian entity's business is software licensing, cloud subscriptions and services — not physical goods.
comment: HS 847330 (parts and accessories of ADP machines of 8471) is only a partial fit. Oracle India's catalogue is dominated by software licences, cloud/SaaS subscriptions, support and training — these are services and have no HS-6 goods code at all, so the declared code cannot describe the bulk of the business. The only genuinely goods-type lines are the engineered systems/servers (8471) and, if actually shipped, spare parts and upgrades (8473.30) and storage media (8523). Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, code corrected to the factual range above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry label 'IT и электроника' is broadly right but imprecise — this is an enterprise software/cloud vendor, not an electronics manufacturer or component trader; no manufacturing plant or component catalogue was found on the Indian site. Trader signs: none found — Oracle India is a subsidiary sales/service entity of the OEM parent, not an independent trader; no IndiaMART/catalogue listings found. Product lines missing from the declaration: cloud subscriptions, software licences, SaaS (Fusion/NetSuite/Health), support and training services, and full server/storage systems (8471) as opposed to merely their parts. IMPORTANT: no customs line, bill of lading or shipping record was found or verified in this pass — the goods-side mapping (8471/8473.30/8523) is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено'; the software/cloud/service lines are documented on oracle.com/in but are services, not shippable goods. Registry, revenue and customs-volume checks were out of scope for this role and were not performed; no CIN/PAN/IEC data is asserted here (null).
